patch_description: Add bounded, pressure-sensitive couplings between links sharing a sender or receiver. A pair of links aimed at high-inbound-pressure destinations, or originating from high-outbound-pressure nodes, receives a stronger congestion penalty. The pressure is normalized from the demand matrix, so the adjustment remains bounded and adapts across instances. This adds at most \(2n\binom{n-1}{2}\) quadratic terms, within the limit, while preserving the direct-demand linear reward. Increase the degree penalty modestly to encourage valid topologies before repair.
